title: [Master] - Bug 656372: [Expense Agent] Fix itemization rounding and missing currency code.
summary: Fixes rounding of Expense Agent itemization amounts and a missing currency code on expense report line items. The change touches the itemization and line item API pages, the line item tables and pages, and the expense rule validation and auto-population codeunits.
key_points: Fixes rounding of expense itemization amounts
Fixes a missing currency code on line items and their API pages
Updates the Expense Report Line Item and Posted Exp. Rep. Line Item tables and pages
Changes expense rule validation and auto-population codeunits
Adds rule violation tests and re-enables previously disabled Expense Agent tests
